name: Tomato and egg
description: Scrambled egg folded through soft tomato — the first thing most Chinese cooks learn.

tcm.note: Egg is neutral; tomato is cool.

ayurveda.note: Anda is ushna; tomato is sour and ushna too.

histamine.note: Egg and tomato — two of the higher everyday ingredients, and this dish is only those two.

nutrition.highlight: the first thing you learn to cook
